2026-08-18.patch_summary: This patch adds a completion barrier helper to the khugepaged selftest, allowing it to drive khugepaged in step and wait for full scans to advance by two. The helper uses sysfs settings to wake the daemon and complete the pass, ensuring that the whole mm list fits within a scan batch. Additionally, the patch updates thp_write_settings() to only write khugepaged knobs when their value changes, preventing unnecessary passes from starting.
